svg.title: Connect a research task to useful tools
svg.desc: Saved TOOLCHAIN.md instructions tell an agent when to use tools and what to report. From a conversation in the app, the agent can operate an installed simulation queue or use a connection to a reference library. The queue produces a run report; the library supplies sources and notes. These are examples of capabilities rather than a list of mandatory tools.
svg.text: Give the agent tools for the research task
The agent operates the tools and reports what happened
